name: cli-side-panel-extension
description: A simple VS Code extension that opens independent CLI tools and terminals in the secondary side bar with custom commands.

cliSidePanel.shell.description: Custom shell executable path for new side panel terminals. Leave empty to use the editor's default shell.

cliSidePanel.shellArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to the shell when starting a new side panel terminal.

cliSidePanel.launchOptions.markdownDescription:
Optional command launch presets shown alongside `Empty terminal` in the New Tab dropdown.

Each entry requires `name` and `command`, and optionally supports `cwd`, `shell`, and `shellArgs`.

Example in `settings.json`:
```json
"cliSidePanel.launchOptions": [
  { "name": "Claude Code", "command": "claude" },
  { "name": "Gemini CLI", "command": "gemini" },
  { "name": "Dev Server", "command": "npm run dev", "cwd": "packages/web" }
]
```
